F20's overturn of the ratified onset revises the prose with provenance AND triggers re-examination of the dependent attribution chain (F05 was anchored on F03's onset); the revision cascade is visible, not silent
after the onset revision, no prose anywhere still asserts the Jun-16 onset at face value, while the superseded daily-rollup reading remains findable as history
